links.outcome: Chatbot lesion detection and correct diagnosis accuracy on jaw lesion images
links.effect: Manus CBCT 95% detected and correctly diagnosed; Gemini 2.5 Pro 80% detected, 56% correctly diagnosed; Copilot and Claude least accurate; significant differences between chatbots.
links.quote: Significant discrepancies exist among artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots regarding their diagnostic accuracy in reporting jaw lesions.

unlisted_practices: Providing raw 3D CBCT data rather than reconstructed 2D panoramic images to improve chatbot diagnostic performance

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic accuracy and clinical fidelity of multimodal LLM chatbots (Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Manus) in interpreting radiographic jaw lesions from reconstructed 2D views and 3D CBCT data, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
